items: 【Newest Android 14 Tablet】 This tablet equipped with the latest Android 14 system, powered by the great and responsive 1.6GHz Quad-core processor, run smoother when open apps and loading the pages. Tablet passed the GMS certification, You can download more apps from Google play. This tablet support widevine L1, Netflix.

【8GB RAM+32GB ROM Tablet】 The tablet offers 8GB RAM (4GB fixed memory, 4GB virtual memory) +32GB of onboard memory and you can add an microSD card up to an additional 1TB of memory, keep all your favorite media with you wherever you go, such as eBooks, songs, videos, photos, music, etc.

【7" Screen + Eye Protection】 The android 14 tablet has a 7-inch high-definition screen. 1024*600 IPS eye protection HD touch screen. The screen is designed to reduce glare and provide greater clarity and brightness. It protects your eyes by reducing the damage caused by blue light, making tablet use safer and more comfortable.

【Easy to Carry】 This small tablet only 7 inch size and lightweight, very easy to hold. You can put it in poket, small bag etc, it well suitable for working and entermainment when home, travel. Due to its convenience, This tablet is well as a gift as a kids tablet for kid.

【The Perfect Gift】 With excellent performance, stylish appearance and elegant packaging, this tablet can be used for watching videos, online learning, surfing the Internet, video conferencing, gaming and entertainment. It's perfect for Christmas, Valentine's Day, birthdays and bar mitzvahs.
